theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_sch_bu_wel_tendsto_integral_of_tendstoUniformlyOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Rn n)) (f : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → ℝ), IsCompact K → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, Integrable (f k)) → Integrable g → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ z, z ∉ K → f k z = 0) → (∀ z, z ∉ K → g z = 0) → TendstoUniformlyOn f g atTop K → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ z, f k z) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z, g z))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
